content: I stand motionlessly in the doorway. Reflected on the glass pane is my face, illuminated by the cold flames around us.

raw: Though filled with fear, our pitiful expressions are one and the same.
content: Though filled with fear, our pitiful expressions are one and the same.

raw: Loughshinny... whose student will you be?
content: Loughshinny... whose student will you be?
